t: Mod bees are only available if their requirements are met. A requirement could be if a a certain mod is installed or the existance of a certain resource added by a mod.
模组蜜蜂只有在满足条件时才会出现。条件可能是装了某个模组，也可能是存在某个模组添加的资源。
